method: Incremental Swap-log scan; fee_per_unit_L summed PER SWAP against each swap's own active liquidity; daily reading = day's fee_per_unit_L / value of one unit of L on the position's range at the day's last scanned tick; a day counts only at >= 20 of 24 hours covered. lpShare uses the worse protocol-fee nibble. Falsifier cadence: three consecutive COMPLETE daily readings under the declared 0.25%/day.
